To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

dialogue is a central feature of the nature of research, of the nature of learning, of learning communities and communities of practice; dialogue is a feature of research support in higher education; and that dialogue can be seen to be of value in its role in supporting research, in the development of learning communities and of communities of practice.

“Dialogues of space, time and practice are central to the nature of research and of research support in higher education, and can contribute to the development of a research culture in higher education institutions.”

the nature of research in higher education is not adequately described by the term ‘research’, but is better understood as a set of practices that can be seen as a ‘community of practice’ or a ‘community of inquiry’.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nature of dialogue in higher and professional education, in the context of research, and with its implications for the nature of research and of higher and professional education.
the role of dialogue in supporting the development of academic research in higher education and with the role of research in higher education.
the nature of dialogue in higher and professional education and the nature of the research that takes place in those settings.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

“dialogue is central to the practice of research and to the practice of supporting research, and that the nature of dialogue in higher educational institutions is a crucial element in understanding research in higher education”.
dialogue is central to research in higher education and that dialogue is itself a form of research.

dialogue is central to the nature of research and learning; dialogue is not only about disseminating knowledge but about developing it and creating it; dialogue can be seen as a way of creating a research community; dialogue can be theorised as a way of understanding the relationship between research and learning; the patterns of dialogue that are identified in this paper, and the nature of research that underpins them, have implications for the nature of higher education and for research policy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

dialogue is a way of being and becoming, of being in the world and becoming in the world, and that dialogue in the world of research in higher education is a way of doing research, and of being researchers.
the nature of research and the nature of dialogue are closely related.
dialogue is an essential part of research in higher education.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the nature of the dialogue that takes places around research, and the nature of the research itself, are inextricably linked, and that this is a key factor in understanding and supporting research in higher education.
dialogue is not only a means to an end, it is an essential part of the end itself.
dialogue is not simply a way of supporting the research of academics; it is a way of understanding research itself, and of supporting the development of the academic community.
